model: BACnet MS/TP module for Supercal 531 / Superstatic 440 / Superstatic 449
applies_to: Sontex Supercal 531 integrators and Superstatic 440 / 449 thermal energy meters fitted with the BACnet MS/TP module (0531A071).
summary: The Sontex BACnet MS/TP module plugs into a Supercal 531 / Superstatic 449 integrator (or a Superstatic 440 meter) and serves its readings as read-only Analog Inputs: energy and volume totals and per-tariff values, two auxiliary pulse counters, flow and return temperatures, power, flow and running hours, plus the same totals stored on two set days. Units follow the meter's configuration.
firmware: Supercal 531 / Superstatic 449 FW 3.7 or later; module software since V2.42.0.10
default_device_instance: Unique ID from the module MCU (readable in Prog531 / Prog449)
notes: Object names carry the instance (e.g. 'AI-10-Power'); they are kept as printed.

Both set-day date objects are printed as 'CA-0' (CA-0-Set-Day1 and CA-0-Set-Day2); they are listed as printed, so the second one clashes with the first. They hold a BACnet date (year, month, day). Check the second calendar's real instance with a device scan.
Units are a list of allowed units; the one in use depends on the meter setup.
The data sheet gives no read/write column; all objects are measurements and are listed read-only.

source.title: BACnet MS/TP module for Sontex Thermal Energy Meters (data sheet with PICS)

integration.summary: Set a unique MS/TP MAC address with Prog531 / Prog449 (the default 255 is auto-MAC), read the device instance from the software, then read energy, power, flow and temperatures.
setup: MS/TP master or slave, MAC 0-127; default MAC 255 (AutoMAC). Change it with Prog531 / Prog449.
Bus termination by DIP switch S1.
gotchas: Energy and volume units depend on the meter configuration (MJ, GJ, Wh, kWh, MWh, BTU; m3 or US gallons).
